query: SELECT ar.cliente, ar.valorOriginal, ar.vencimentoData, ar.tipo, ar.centroDeCustosId FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.vencimentoData < CURDATE() AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cobranca_planilha cp WHERE UPPER(TRIM(cp.empresa)) = UPPER(TRIM(ar.cliente)) AND ABS(CAST(cp.valor AS DECIMAL(15,2)) - CAST(ar.valorOriginal AS DECIMAL(15,2))) < 0.02 ) ORDER BY ar.cliente LIMIT 20;
